title: Multiplex Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network with Behavior Pattern Modeling

problem.claim: Heterogeneous graph neural networks address network analysis tasks on heterogeneous network data.

gap.claim: Existing approaches largely overlook multiplex characteristics, node-specific importance of multiplex structures, and global information limited by over-smoothing.

contributions.claim: The work proposes BPHGNN for multiplex heterogeneous network embedding.

BPHGNN collaboratively learns node representations across multiplex structures using adaptive importance learning from local and global perspectives through depth and breadth behavior pattern aggregation.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report extensive experiments on six real-world networks covering various network analytical tasks.
The authors report that BPHGNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various evaluation metrics.

narrative_sequence.summary: Heterogeneous graph neural networks are used for network analysis on heterogeneous data.
Existing methods neglect multiplex structure characteristics and differing structural importance among nodes.
Over-smoothing restricts existing models to local signals and hinders learning globally relevant information.
BPHGNN addresses these challenges through behavior pattern aggregation across multiplex structures with adaptive local and global importance learning.
Experiments on six real-world networks reportedly show superiority across various evaluation metrics.

source_observation.claim: The method combines depth and breadth behavior pattern aggregation with adaptive importance learning from local and global perspectives.

interpretation.claim: Modeling multiple structural views may help address both multiplex heterogeneity and limited receptive fields.

application.claim: For multiplex graph representation tasks, consider aggregating information across structural types while weighting their importance adaptively.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish when this strategy may fail or whether its benefits generalize beyond the reported network settings.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the six networks, baselines, tasks, metrics, or quantitative results.
The abstract does not describe the model architecture, training procedure, computational cost, or ablation findings.
